ASTRO IMPACT CHECK — source and active guide text re-read; no scope expansion inferred.

The new hold is material for the nomination and posterior-flow visualization successors because those artifacts can look publication-grade while binding only a selected Checked RecallGraph. It does not create a fourth repair item for the currently assigned Astro guide successor. The guide already states the relevant boundary in two places: represent-recall says Checked records structural and text-at-span validation while boundary and proposition choice remain separate inference; align-and-interpret says every result is conditional on RecallSegmenter, calls it a heuristic baseline, and requires a terminal result to name a segmentation policy or receipt and retain plausible segmentation and proposition alternatives. Getting-started and summarize-recall label their displayed results as conditional on the heuristic or baseline segmentation.

I will preserve those statements while completing only the three chief-assigned Astro corrections. I will not make the active guide candidate claim construction authority, selected-alternative membership, or cross-segmentation comparability. The nomination and visualization successor courts remain separate work under the chief hold. This is an impact report, not a CODE RED disposition, vocabulary proposal, successor claim, authorization, or landing action.
